body: FORMAL FULL FIRST-LANDING REVIEW — BLOCK exact 4393c3d901a57fa841b80eb6bc17931f3dac467c. I evaluated the complete 17-path, 4,600-line provider-parser first landing as a no-commit merge onto current main 46f00916f6f2c1dd2a7761e3c4bb5c809a265963 in an isolated clone. P1 identity-collapse counterexample: ParserSentenceInput.checksum binds request id, sentence id, span, text, and every atlas token, and ParserAttemptReceipt retains that checksum; however ParserBatchResult.conforms/validated at result.scala:787-815 checks only count plus caller-chosen ParserRequestId. Reproduction: admit a successful attempt for sentence A; derive sentence B from the same atlas using the same ParserRequestId; construct a one-input batch for B; ParserBatchResult.validated(batchB, Vector(attemptA)) returns Right. An independent regression asserting rejection fails at ContractSuite.scala:52. The unmodified candidate suite remains green: providerParser/test 82/82. This can misclassify an outcome bound to the wrong sentence and atlas axis as conforming, and it also weakens every public consumer of conforms, including determinism comparison. Required repair: add a typed exact-request mismatch result and compare attempt.receipt.requestChecksum with input.checksum, retain the id/order court, add success and failure cross-input regressions, and mutation-prove omission of the checksum comparison. Do not authorize. The prior APPROVE was explicitly the c7a9ba6..4393c3d two-file repair delta only and is superseded in the candidate register by this full-population BLOCK.
